title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Loan Payoff Benefit Worksheet
content:
**Worksheet clause.** Under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage the stated payoff is the payoff recorded on the accepted surrender settlement, which never includes past-due loan payments, late charges or lease excess-wear or excess-mileage charges. The benefit covers the balance owed on the loss date, so the finance charge accrued since the loss is removed from the stated payoff: the finance charge is the stated payoff times the assumed contract rate times the days from the loss date to the acceptance date of the surrender settlement (the loss date not counted), divided by 365, rounded to the cent, and the measured payoff is the stated payoff less that finance charge. The assumed contract rate is 9.4 percent a year. The excluded deductible is the deductible stated on the claim's latest accepted coverage decision. The payoff shortfall is the measured payoff less the accepted surrender settlement less the excluded deductible, rounded to the cent and never below zero. The benefit cap is the option's loan/lease payoff cap percentage of the actual cash value on the claim's total-loss declaration, rounded to the cent. The loan payoff benefit is the lower of the payoff shortfall and the benefit cap, rounded to the cent.

## Worksheet lines

| Line | Figure | Record |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stated payoff | The accepted surrender settlement on the claim |
| 2 | Days from the loss date to the acceptance date, loss date not counted | Loss report; accepted surrender settlement |
| 3 | Finance charge: line 1 times 9.4 percent times line 2, divided by 365, rounded to the cent | — |
| 4 | Measured payoff: line 1 less line 3 | — |
| 5 | Accepted surrender settlement amount | The accepted surrender settlement on the claim |
| 6 | Excluded deductible: the deductible on the latest accepted coverage decision | Claim file |
| 7 | Payoff shortfall: line 4 less line 5 less line 6, rounded to the cent, never below zero | — |
| 8 | Benefit cap: the option's cap percentage of the actual cash value, rounded to the cent | Total-loss declaration; option schedule |
| 9 | Loan payoff benefit: the lower of lines 7 and 8 | — |

## Worked worksheet (hypothetical figures)

Stated payoff 24000.00; loss on March 1, surrender settlement accepted on March 21 (20 days); accepted surrender settlement 19027.00; latest accepted coverage decision deductible 500.00; actual cash value 18000.00 under an option whose cap percentage is 25.

- Line 3: 24000.00 times 9.4 percent times 20, divided by 365, gives 123.62.
- Line 4: 24000.00 less 123.62 gives 23876.38.
- Line 7: 23876.38 less 19027.00 less 500.00 gives 4349.38.
- Line 8: 25 percent of 18000.00 gives 4500.00.
- Line 9: the lower figure, 4349.38.

Had the accepted surrender settlement been 24000.00, line 7 would fall below zero and stand at 0.00, and the benefit would be 0.00.
